text: Okay. Talk to me.
We are three weeks into the portal project, and I can not tell if we are making money. Hours are in one sheet, costs in another, billing in a third.
The client needs three Java developers by Monday! Candidates are in email, interview notes on paper, and I do not know who is already deployed.
Attendance does not match, leave balances are wrong, and a new joiner starts tomorrow with no checks done.
Machine four has stopped, and nobody knows why. The order is due Friday, and stores can not confirm the material.
This batch failed inspection, and I can not trace which material lot it came from.
We can not bill the client. The timesheets and dispatch papers have not reached us.
Who has the laptop for the new hire? The asset register is out of date.
Every team is working hard. So why are we always behind?
It is not the people. Nothing is connected. Every team keeps its own sheet, its own version of the truth, and every problem lands on the founder's desk.
Synax ERP brings it all onto one platform. Each team gets its own workspace, on shared data.
Projects: the work tracker logs the hours, cost mapper adds up the costs, and billing and project analytics sit side by side.
Staffing: one flow from the client's requirement to candidates, interviews, offers and deployment, then timesheets, invoices and payments.
H R: one employee record, from the manpower request and the offer, to pre-joining checks, the employee portal, reviews and exit.
Manufacturing: follow every order from the customer P O to material, route card and schedule, with live monitoring and downtime on the floor.
Quality: inspection, N C R and CAPA, and genealogy that traces any part back to its order, material lot, machine and operator.
Finance and assets: invoices, debit and credit notes, every asset assigned to a person, and access control for who sees what.
And Synax A I keeps watch. Agents flag exceptions, like overdue challans, and propose a fix. Nothing changes until someone with the right role approves.
Less juggling. More visibility. Better control.
From disconnected teams to one connected business. Synax ERP.
